2586-3899-4186.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat

116-512-3814.easyPrerequisites: Argothian Elder and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
116-512-3814.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands that can collectively tap to produce {W}{W}.
116-512-3814.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping the two lands.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Argothian Elder, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

4478-5078-6918-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1479-2841-7889-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-7889-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

240-3899-4460-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

997-1011-2728-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
997-1011-2728-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
997-1011-2728-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 4.

654-851-2557-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

431-3129-4365-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-3129-4365-7824.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

215-850-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-7060.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5147-5542-6143.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6143.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Feywild Caretaker from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Feywild Caretaker.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Feywild Caretaker token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6143.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1368-1879-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1879-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

193-1124-2724-6432.description:
Activate Aminatou's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Aminatou's second ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Repeat each turn.

4149-4599-4871-4927-6019.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

372-2955-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2955-7487.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Zealous Lorecaster and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Zealous Lorecaster trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Zealous Lorecaster and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

240-4359-5147-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4742-6438.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4742-6438.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2308-3188-4050-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-3188-4050-4871.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Social Climber triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Social Climber trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a stun counter on it

514-654-5686-5944.description:
Activate The Mycosynth Gardens' third ability by paying {1} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Amulet of Vigor.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
When Unstoppable Slasher enters, Amulet of Vigor and The Mycosynth Gardens trigger, untapping Unstoppable Slasher twice, which will instead remove both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-3200-4404.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Urza's Bauble.
Cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Corridor Monitor.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

339-677-997-4785.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a memory counter on it

3951-4772-5703-6646.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-4772-5703-6646.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1690-2538-2585-4985.notablePrerequisites: You have a historic card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Jhoira's Familiar.
1690-2538-2585-4985.description:
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast a historic creature by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Grim Monolith to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost reduced by {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2538-2585-4985.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

5941-6452.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant or sorcery card in hand with enough mana to cast it.
You have enough mana to cast Wild Ricochet
5941-6452.description:
Cast the additional instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
If Adaptive Training Post had two charge counters on it, it triggers, putting a charge counter on it.
Holding priority, activate Adaptive Training Post by removing three charge counters from it, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn.
Cast Wild Ricochet by paying its mana cost, targeting the spell cast in step 1.
Adaptive Training Post triggers, copying Wild Ricochet, with the copy targeting the original Wild Ricochet.
Resolve the copy of Wild Ricochet, copying the original Wild Ricochet, with the copy targeting the original Wild Ricochet.
Repeat step 5.

2178-4094-4660-5676.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Bloodshot Cyclops.
2178-4094-4660-5676.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
Bloodshot Cyclops does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4094-4660-5676.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing Reef Worm.
When Reef Worm dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Reef Worm trigger, creating two 3/3 Fish creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 2.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Fish.
When the Fish dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Fish trigger, creating two 6/6 Whale creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 7, dealing damage equal to the FIsh's power to any target.
Repeat from step 7 using the other Fish token.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Whale.
When the Whale dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Whale trigger, creating two 9/9 Kraken creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 13, dealing damage equal to the Whale's power to any target.
Repeat from step 13 for each other Whale token.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Kraken.
When the Kraken dies, Bloodshot Cyclops triggers, untapping Bloodshot Cyclops.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 19, dealing damage equal to the Kraken's power to any target.
Repeat from step 19 for each other Kraken token.

222-527-2292-3480.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2292-3480.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

190-389-3778-6036.description:
Activate The Book of Exalted Deeds by paying {W}{W}{W}, tapping and exiling it, putting an enlightened counter on an Angel you control.
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, however you cannot lose the game due to The Book of Exalted Deeds.
Cast Austere Command by paying its mana cost, destroying all enchantments.
When each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, they each trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

3327-3967-4549.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game
3327-3967-4549.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Dargo, adding {R}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

333-3967-4775.notablePrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-3967-4775.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1339-1636-4067-5804.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures.
1339-1636-4067-5804.description:
Activate Heirloom Epic by tapping it and four creatures you control, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Heirloom Epic.
Repeat.

3924-4050-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Deep Forest Hermit to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Deep Forest Hermit enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing Deep Forest Hermit and the four Squirrel tokens, adding {4}{B}.
Repeat.

1467-2397-3634-4872.notablePrerequisites: You haven't copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
1467-2397-3634-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, copying Time Warp.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Time Warp to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3749-4067-4653.notablePrerequisites:
At least five creatures have died this turn.
Lagomos does not have summoning sickness.
3749-4067-4653.description:
Activate Lagomos by tapping it, searching your library for Dread and putting it into your hand.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Dread, targeting Lagomos.
Dread triggers, shuflling it from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Mind over Matter trigger, untapping Lagomos.
Repeat.

224-1315-2366-2532-3875.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
224-1315-2366-2532-3875.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
The Dryad Arbor token enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Jaxis.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing the Dryad Arbor token.
The Dryad Arbor token dies, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability, causing you to gain two life.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness

116-283-3388.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Moritte of the Frost.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Moritte of the Frost and another permanent you control.
Activate Moritte of the Frost by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

1971-4050-4681.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Yannik, adding one mana of any color.
Yannik leaves the battlefield, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, returning Yannik from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Yannik enters the battlefield, exiling Karmic Guide until Yannik leaves the battlefield and distributing two +1/+1 counters among creatures you control.
Repeat.

225-3230-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
225-3230-3525.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat any number of times.

953-1371-3032.description:
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Enter the Infinite.
Resolve each Enter the Infinite, causing each player to draw their entire library, put a card from their hand on top of their library, and have no maximum hand size until their next turn.
At the beginning of each opponent's draw step, Kami triggers, causing them to draw an additional card and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
